name: usage-band-mod
description: A one-line band above the prompt with model, cost and bars for context, the 5-hour session, the week and per-model limits, plus a native settings window on macOS (and a preview of one on Windows).

idioma.title: Language / Idioma
idioma.description: Language of the band, the settings window and the commands.

moeda.title: Currency
moeda.description: Currency for the session cost. USD needs no network; the others use Coinbase's public USD rates.

mascote.title: Mascot
mascote.description: The pixel crab next to the model name: animated, still, or hidden.

limitePorModelo.title: Per-model weekly limit
limitePorModelo.description: Shows per-model weekly limits (e.g. Fable). Reads an internal Anthropic endpoint that has no public documentation and may change.
